rationale: Class 1 row-validation issue: the bundle reports X02 rows where private credit positions have blank interest_rate and basis_spread, including senior subordinated loans. Raw SOI source rows have populated Coupon cells for matching instruments, including 14.00 % PIK on the continuation senior subordinated loan row following the 15484880 Canada issuer block and 12.16 % PIK for 22 HoldCo Limited. The missing extracted rates are therefore source-contradicted extraction gaps, not a valid source blank or aggregate-anchor issue.
